acceptedAnswer.text: ReviewPing is an automated review request platform that helps small businesses get more Google reviews via email and WhatsApp. It's the ₹599/month alternative to Podium — built for restaurants, clinics, salons, and e-commerce businesses.

mainEntity.name: How does the review request automation work?

acceptedAnswer.text: You add your customers' names and contact info, choose a template, and ReviewPing sends a personalised email or WhatsApp message with a direct Google review link. You can send individually or in bulk. All requests are tracked in your dashboard.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a Google Business Profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you need a verified Google Business Profile to receive Google reviews. ReviewPing helps you get more reviews on your existing profile — we don't create or manage the profile itself.

mainEntity.name: Can I send both email and WhatsApp?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can send review requests via email, WhatsApp, or let the customer choose. WhatsApp works best for restaurants and retail. Email is preferred for clinics and professional services.
Yes. We follow GDPR and UK privacy regulations. Every review request includes an opt-out link, and we never send unsolicited messages. You own your customer data — we never share or sell it.

mainEntity.name: Can I try before I buy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can use our free Google Review Link Generator without signing up. The Starter plan is ₹599/month with 100 review requests, no commitment, cancel anytime.

mainEntity.name: How is ReviewPing different from Podium?

acceptedAnswer.text: ReviewPing is built for small businesses who don't need Podium's enterprise complexity. We charge ₹599/month instead of Podium's $449+/month. Same core review request functionality, no bloated features, no long-term contracts.

Yes. Our Agency plan (₹1,499/month) includes white-label branding, multi-location management, up to 10 team members, and dedicated onboarding. Perfect for marketing agencies managing reviews for clients.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to set up ReviewPing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Setting up ReviewPing takes approximately 2 minutes. Create your account, connect your Google Business Profile, choose or customise a review request template, and import your customer contacts. There's no onboarding call, no complex integration, and no waiting period — you can start sending automated review requests immediately after signing up.

mainEntity.name: Can I use ReviewPing for multiple Google Business Profiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. ReviewPing's multi-location plan supports multiple Google Business Profiles under one account. Each location gets its own review request settings, message templates, and analytics dashboard. Switch between locations with one click and manage all your Google reviews from a single, unified interface.

Yes. ReviewPing supports WhatsApp review requests on all paid plans. WhatsApp offers a 98% open rate within 5 minutes — significantly higher than email. Your customers receive a friendly WhatsApp message with a direct Google review link, making it effortless for them to leave feedback on their preferred messaging platform.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I exceed my monthly review request limit?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you exceed your plan's monthly limit, ReviewPing pauses new automated requests until the next billing cycle or until you upgrade to a higher tier. You'll receive a notification before hitting your limit so you can plan ahead. Upgrade at any time with no penalties, no service interruptions, and no overage fees.

mainEntity.name: Can I customise the email and WhatsApp templates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. ReviewPing gives you full control over your review request templates. You can customise every word of your email and WhatsApp messages, use personalisation tags like customer name and service details, add emojis, and adjust the tone to match your brand voice. We also provide industry-optimised default templates to get you started quickly.

mainEntity.name: Does ReviewPing integrate with my POS or booking system?

acceptedAnswer.text: ReviewPing supports CSV import for easy integration with most POS systems, booking platforms, and CRMs. Simply export your customer data from your existing system and upload it to ReviewPing. For custom integrations, our API allows developers to connect ReviewPing directly with your existing software for fully automated review request workflows.

mainEntity.name: How does ReviewPing handle opt-outs and unsubscribes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every email and WhatsApp review request sent through ReviewPing includes a one-click opt-out link or reply-to-stop option. When a customer unsubscribes, they are automatically removed from all future campaigns. We maintain a permanent opt-out record to ensure full compliance with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and UK privacy regulations at all times.

ReviewPing offers email support for all plans with a typical response time of under 4 hours during business hours. Premium and Agency plan customers receive priority support with faster response times and a dedicated account manager. Our knowledge base also includes comprehensive setup guides, template examples, and best practice articles for self-service help.
